name: What kind of paint should I choose for my interior walls?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint should I choose for my interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint depends on the specific room and your lifestyle. For high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms, washable and durable paints with a satin or semi-gloss finish are often recommended. For living areas and bedrooms, matte or eggshell finishes offer a softer look. We can guide you through the options, considering durability, finish, and color preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best paint depends on the room. Durable, washable paints are good for high-traffic areas; matte or eggshell for living spaces. We can help you choose.
